description:
Advances: specled.api_boundary

Review-bar-override: four pure refactors on the hot path of a release branch — deferred as a batch for the same reason the review dropped a sibling readability finding.

From the critical review of specled_-n5q. All four are Low, all four are consensus findings (idioms + simplicity), and none change behavior. Batched because they touch the same two modules and are best done in one pass with the suite as the check.

1. F10 — hash decoding implemented twice across a module boundary. ApiBoundary.entry_hash/1 is a character-for-character copy of the decode inside HashStore.fetch/3. Introduced by this branch: splitting out fetch_entry/3 was right, but the decode was copied rather than moved. Fix: one public HashStore.entry_hash/1, compose fetch/3 from it, delete the private copy. HashStore owns the on-disk format; ApiBoundary should not know a hash is hex. (Note: the branch DID add an is_binary guard to the ApiBoundary copy, so the two are no longer identical — reconcile when merging them.)

2. F9 — Orchestrator.api_boundary_hashes/2 hand-rolls the dedupe that dedupe_by_mfa/2 already does. Both reviewers produced the same behavior-preserving sketch: widen the callback to return the entry, route through the existing helper, delete the "parity by construction" comment. ~10 fewer lines.

3. F13 — Map.get(f, "code") or Map.get(f, :code) written four times: has_drift?, has_dangling?, has_divergence?, plus an inline copy in drift_dangling_pairs/1. Fix: finding_code/1 + has_code?/2 + module attributes for the three codes; drive drift_dangling_pairs/1 from the same attribute and rename it for what it now does (it covers divergence too).

4. F11 — comment blocks restating ADRs committed in the same branch. The assume-beam refutation lives in five places; this ticket own history records two restatements that had already gone false and needed a remediation commit. Trim the refuted-alternative paragraph in comparable?/2 and the 381-binding incident history in collect_bindings/2 to one-line ADR pointers. Keep the 4-tuple vs 5-tuple envelope paragraph — that one earns its place.

## ORCHESTRATOR CONTRACT (specled_-i4x)

Advances: specled.api_boundary, specled.binding, specled.branch_guard

(CORRECTED by orchestrator — the ticket carried only specled.api_boundary. The four items span
three modules owned by three subjects:
  F10 decode dedup       -> hash_store.ex:150-163 + api_boundary.ex:191-201 -> binding + api_boundary
  F9  api_boundary_hashes/2 -> orchestrator.ex:966-1006                      -> branch_guard
  F13 code-check helpers -> orchestrator.ex:396-414, 686-708                 -> branch_guard
  F11 comment trims      -> api_boundary.ex:164-184 + orchestrator.ex:478-490 -> api_boundary + branch_guard)

DECISION-CLASS: NO. Code only. Merge without hold. Four behavior-preserving refactors, no new
requirement, no ADR, no stub flip, no baseline movement. Spec-file touches are
surface-ownership bookkeeping only.

RUNS FIRST IN ITS LINEAGE. specled_-vzd.2 and specled_-vzd.6 are wired to depend on this ticket.
Note the deliberate priority inversion: this is P4 and vzd.2 is P3, but the dependency runs this
way because vzd.4 F13's rename of drift_dangling_pairs/1 would otherwise land on a function
vzd.2 just reshaped.

CORRECTION TO A COMMON ASSUMPTION: making HashStore.entry_hash/1 public does NOT move an
api_boundary hash. .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly ONE tier (api_boundary, 173
entries, no implementation section). No SpecLedEx.Realization.* module is bound bare, so no
head-union hash recomputes when HashStore gains an export; HashStore's bound MFAs are only
read/2, write/2, merge/2, whose heads are untouched. Hashing is also line-shift stable, so
inserting a function above write/2 does not move it either.

Allowed touches:
- lib/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary.ex
- lib/specled_ex/realization/hash_store.ex
- lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex
- .spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md
- .spec/specs/binding.spec.md
- .spec/specs/branch_guard.spec.md
- test/specled_ex/realization/api_boundary_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/hash_store_test.exs
- test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs
- .spec/realization_hashes.json — ESCAPE HATCH ONLY. It should NOT need to change; a diff here
  means something behavioral leaked in. Stop and re-read your diff.
NO ADR. Do not touch .spec/decisions/.

Out of Scope (files):
- the other nine lib/specled_ex/realization/*.ex
- docs/**
- lib/specled_ex/branch_check.ex

Out of Scope (intent):
- ZERO behavior change. If any test changes its expected values, STOP — the refactor is wrong.
- F10: reconcile the is_binary guard the release branch added to the ApiBoundary copy
  (api_boundary.ex:191) with HashStore.fetch/3's unguarded decode (hash_store.ex:154-158). The
  merged public entry_hash/1 keeps the guarded nil-returning behavior AND the malformed-entry
  rationale at api_boundary.ex:198-201 (4 lines, load-bearing — MOVE it, do not delete it).
- F13: do not add a fourth code and do not change any code string. Deduplicate the four
  Map.get(f, "code") || Map.get(f, :code) sites only.
- F11: KEEP the 4-tuple/5-tuple envelope paragraph (api_boundary.ex:164-167) — it earns its
  place. Trim only :168-184 (the assume-beam refutation) and orchestrator.ex:484-490 (the
  381-binding incident history) to one-line specled.decision.* pointers.
- Do NOT "while I'm here" fix orchestrator.ex:809-822's bare "See atlas-vmi." pointer. Out of
  scope, and it names a non-ADR.

Verification:
  mix compile --warnings-as-errors
  mix test                                    # FULL suite — this is a behavior-preservation
                                              # claim, so the scope is deliberately wide
  mix format --check-formatted
  mix deps.unlock --check-unused
  make xref
  git diff --stat .spec/realization_hashes.json   # MUST be empty
  bash ./scripts/check_specs.sh
No stub flips. No new requirements.

Expected diff: 6-9 files, ~140 changed lines, NET -40 (F9 alone ~-10; F11 ~-25).

Ownership checks out: hash_store.ex is in binding.spec.md's surface, orchestrator.ex in branch_guard.spec.md's, api_boundary.ex in api_boundary.spec.md's. api_boundary's summary generalizing "emits drift and dangling findings" to "emits realization findings" is strictly more accurate now that a third code (resolution_path_divergence) exists.

- Targeted verification (all from /Users/mz/src/specled_ex-realization-cleanups):

Verdict: FAIL

Gaps:
- lib/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator.ex:760, :769, :778 (against :958-967) — F9 changed dedupe_by_mfa/2's callback contract from "return {:ok, raw_hash_binary}, helper wraps it via hash_entry/1" to "return {:ok, fully_formed_entry}". At base, dedupe_by_mfa did `Map.put(acc, mfa, hash_entry(hash_bin))`; at HEAD it does `Map.put(acc, mfa, entry)`. The three compute_tier_hashes/3 clauses (:903, :912, :921) were correctly updated to call hash_entry/1 themselves. The three compute_seed_hashes/3 clauses for :expanded_behavior, :typespecs and :use were NOT — they still return the raw binary. The SEED path therefore now writes 32 raw SHA-256 bytes where an entry map belongs, and HashStore.merge/2 crashes on them.

  Failing scenario, executed both ways (script: Orchestrator.run with a single :typespecs binding, enabled_tiers: [:typespecs], commit_hashes?: true, umbrella?: false, empty root):
    base bb64e69e -> findings: []; .spec/realization_hashes.json written as
        "typespecs": {"SpecLedEx.Realization.HashStore.fetch/3":
          {"hash": "d1cc15f5...b927", "hasher_version": 1}}
    HEAD 18af5f26 -> ** (FunctionClauseError) no function clause matching in
        SpecLedEx.Realization.HashStore.ensure_version/1
        # 1: <<209, 204, 21, 245, 137, 189, 107, 224, ...>>
        (spec_led_ex) lib/specled_ex/realization/hash_store.ex:314: ensure_version/1
        (spec_led_ex) lib/specled_ex/realization/hash_store.ex:117: anonymous fn/1 in merge/2
  I isolated this to orchestrator.ex alone: reverting only that one file to base makes the script pass, restoring it makes it crash. Tree left clean.

  Reachability: seed_uncommitted_hashes/3 (:713) iterates @flat_tiers = [:api_boundary, :expanded_behavior, :typespecs, :use] on every Orchestrator.run where commit_hashes? != false and umbrella? == false — i.e. the default gate path. Any adopter with an uncommitted expanded_behavior, typespecs or use binding hits this hard crash on their next `mix spec.check`.

  Why every gate stayed green: this repo declares ZERO expanded_behavior/typespecs/use bindings (grep over .spec/specs/ returns nothing; the baseline has one tier, api_boundary/173). The one multi-tier orchestrator test (orchestrator_test.exs:225-245) runs with umbrella?: true AND commit_hashes?: false, so it skips seeding entirely. The full suite will not catch this — the path is untested, which is exactly how a contract-widening refactor slipped past a "zero behavior change" claim.

  Fix is three lines: make :760, :769, :778 return {:ok, hash_entry(hash_bin)} to match the compute_tier_hashes/3 clauses. (Reporting only — not applied.)

Notes:
- Sibling advisory, no action needed for this ticket: F9's mandate to delete the "parity by construction" comment also removed its statement that seed and refresh MUST produce identical entries for the same bindings (the specled_-rot oscillation history). That invariant is now recorded nowhere in the tree — and the Gap above is precisely a seed/refresh divergence. Worth a line in whatever ADR or spec requirement the fix lands against; may fit specled_-vzd.6's "comment blocks must end in an ADR pointer" scope.
- The unrecognized-label pointer nit under F11 is cheap to fix in the same pass: point that clause at .spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md's requirement rather than the ADR, or amend the ADR.

AUDIT: BOUNCE → implementer
Session: 9a42db78-611e-4632-882a-adaefdaa666f
Log: /Users/mz/.claude-personal/projects/-Users-mz-src-specled-ex/9a42db78-611e-4632-882a-adaefdaa666f.jsonl

Verifier's Gap CONFIRMED, independently and by a fresh reproduction.

Static trace (established by reading, not inherited):
- dedupe_by_mfa/2 at orchestrator.ex:958-967 now does `{:ok, entry} -> Map.put(acc, mfa, entry)`.
  At base it did `Map.put(acc, mfa, hash_entry(hash_bin))`. Callback contract widened by F9.
- Seven call sites. compute_tier_hashes/3 (:904, :913, :922) and api_boundary_hashes/2 (:935) return
  fully-formed entries. compute_seed_hashes/3 (:758, :767, :776) still return `{:ok, hash_bin}` —
  a raw binary from ExpandedBehavior/Typespecs/Use.hash/1 (@type hash_result, binary payload).
- seed_uncommitted_hashes/3 (:713) puts that map straight into `seeds` and calls HashStore.merge/2
  (:748). merge/2 at hash_store.ex:117 maps every entry through ensure_version/1, which has exactly
  two clauses (hash_store.ex:314-317), both requiring a map. A raw binary matches neither.

Reproduction at HEAD (Orchestrator.run, single :typespecs binding, enabled_tiers: [:typespecs],
commit_hashes?: true, umbrella?: false, empty temp root):
  CRASHED: no function clause matching in SpecLedEx.Realization.HashStore.ensure_version/1
Tree left clean (git status --porcelain empty); repro script lives in scratchpad, not the repo.
I did not re-run the base side — the base `Map.put(acc, mfa, hash_entry(hash_bin))` makes base
correctness conclusive from the diff alone.

Production reachability: CONFIRMED, and BROADER than the verifier stated.
orchestrator.ex:177-185 — `commit_hashes?` defaults to TRUE, `umbrella?` defaults to FALSE, so the
seed pass runs on the default path. branch_check.ex:225 passes `commit_realization_hashes?`
defaulting to true. Critically, branch_check.ex:230-235 only sets :enabled_tiers when
`config.realization.enabled_tiers` is non-nil, and config/realization.ex:26 defaults it to nil —
so Orchestrator falls back to @default_tiers = [:api_boundary, :expanded_behavior, :typespecs,
:use]. An adopter does NOT need to opt in to the broken tiers; they are on by default. The only
precondition is one uncommitted expanded_behavior/typespecs/use binding that hashes successfully.
That adopter's next `mix spec.check` hard-crashes. Not synthetic. Not a Note.
(:api_boundary and :implementation seeding are unaffected — api_boundary routes through
api_boundary_hashes/2, and seed_implementation_subjects/4 does not use dedupe_by_mfa/2.)

Why gates stayed green: CONFIRMED — the full suite does NOT catch it.
- .spec/realization_hashes.json has exactly one tier: api_boundary, 173 entries. Zero
  expanded_behavior/typespecs/use bindings declared anywhere in .spec/specs/.
- Enumerated all 47 Orchestrator.run call sites in test/. Every run that leaves commit_hashes? at
  its true default is scoped to enabled_tiers [:api_boundary] and/or [:implementation]. Exactly two
  tests touch the three broken tiers: orchestrator_test.exs:229-233 (umbrella?: true AND
  commit_hashes?: false) and :257-260 ([:expanded_behavior], commit_hashes?: false). Both skip
  seeding. The seed path for those three tiers has zero test coverage at base and at HEAD.

Spot-check of F10 / F13 / F11 — verifier's PASSes hold; nothing missed:
- F10: guard `when is_binary(hash)` preserved (hash_store.ex:182); 3-line malformed-entry rationale
  MOVED verbatim to :188-190, not deleted; fetch/3 composed from entry_hash/1; fetch_entry/3
  (:172-178) already filters to `%{"hash" => _}` so the only base/HEAD divergence is non-binary
  "hash" -> raise becomes nil, which is the reconciliation the contract mandated. Envelope-paragraph
  and call-site checks clean.
- F13: finding_code/1 keeps `Map.get(f, "code") || Map.get(f, :code)` verbatim — string AND atom
  forms preserved at all four sites. @unattested_codes is the same three strings byte-identical, no
  fourth code. has_drift?'s two-pass disjunction is logically identical to the single-pass one.
  Rename: `grep -rn drift_dangling_pairs lib/ test/ .spec/ docs/` returns ZERO; unattested_pairs has
  exactly its definition (:400) and its one call site (:254). Clean.
- F11: 4-tuple/5-tuple envelope paragraph RETAINED verbatim at api_boundary.ex:163-166; only the
  assume-beam block below it and the 381-binding block at :479 were trimmed to pointers. Correct.

Bounce reason — three things, all in orchestrator.ex:

1. FIX THE DEFECT. The verifier's three-line fix (wrap :758/:767/:776 in hash_entry/1) is
   sufficient for correctness, but it is the weaker remedy. compute_seed_hashes/3 and
   compute_tier_hashes/3 are now clause-for-clause identical across all five clauses — both
   delegate :api_boundary to api_boundary_hashes/2, both catch-all to %{}, and the three flat-tier
   clauses would be byte-identical once the wrap is restored. PREFERRED: delete compute_seed_hashes/3
   outright and have seed_uncommitted_hashes/3 (:726) call compute_tier_hashes/3. That makes
   seed/refresh entry parity structural instead of a duplicated pair that can drift again — which is
   exactly the failure mode that just occurred. Either fix is acceptable; the delegation one is
   strictly better and nets further lines off, consistent with the ticket's stated intent.

2. REGRESSION TEST REQUIRED — non-negotiable. An untested path is precisely how this passed six
   green gates and a change-scoped verification tier. Add to
   test/specled_ex/realization/orchestrator_test.exs (in Allowed touches) a test that runs
   Orchestrator.run with commit_hashes?: true, umbrella?: false, enabled_tiers including at least
   one of [:expanded_behavior, :typespecs, :use], one resolvable uncommitted binding, and an empty
   root. It must assert on the WRITTEN BASELINE — that .spec/realization_hashes.json contains an
   entry of shape %{"hash" => <lowercase hex string>, "hasher_version" => n} for that MFA — not
   merely that the call did not raise. Asserting no-crash would pass against a future entry-shape
   regression that writes a differently-malformed map. Note this is NEW coverage of a path that was
   untested at base, so it does not violate the ZERO-behavior-change intent: no existing test's
   expected values may change.

3. RESTORE THE INVARIANT (the verifier's Note — I agree it belongs in this bounce, not deferred).
   F9's mandated deletion of the "parity by construction" comment removed the tree's only record
   that seed and refresh MUST produce identical entries for the same bindings (specled_-rot
   oscillation history). The defect above IS a seed/refresh divergence, so that deletion is causally
   implicated, not incidental. Restore it as a short comment on dedupe_by_mfa/2 stating the callback
   contract ("callbacks return a fully-formed entry ready for HashStore.merge/2") plus the
   seed/refresh parity requirement. Comment only — the contract says NO ADR and no .spec/decisions/
   touch, and remedy 1's delegation would make the parity half self-evident in code anyway.

Not in scope for this bounce (advisory only, do NOT fix here): the verifier's F11 nit that
api_boundary.ex's unrecognized-label pointer aims at specled.decision.resolution_path_provenance
while that content lives at .spec/specs/api_boundary.spec.md:88-95. Accurate observation, cosmetic,
and touching it now widens a bounce that needs to stay tight.

Route note: the verifier's output was correct on every point I could check, and its stated
reachability was if anything understated. No bounce to verifier.

Mechanical-remedy bounce count this ticket: 1/2
